# CI artifact manifest

projections.artifact.json at the root of the `projections` Actions artifact: what one workflow run extracted or compared, and the full-byte SHA-256 of every document it uploaded. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/artifact/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/artifact/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/artifact/v0.json).

## Definitions

### `commit`

Type: string. Pattern `^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$`.

### `id`

Type: integer. At least 1. At most 9007199254740991.

### `notices`

Type: array of string. At most 20 items.

### `path`

Type: string. Pattern `^projections/[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,99}\.json$`.

### `sha256`

Type: string. Pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`.

### `diagnostic`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity` | `"error"` or `"warning"` | Yes |  |
| `code` | string | Yes | At least 1 character. At most 100 characters. |
| `path` | string | Yes | At most 1024 characters. |
| `message` | string | Yes | At least 1 character. At most 4096 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.
